verdicts.reason: A breaks the key illustration: the heart and a tiny fragment of the hand float apart, so it no longer reads as a hand holding a heart. The URL hangs loose at the top. The CTA wraps into a narrow, cramped column that almost touches the contact text beside it, which is small and jammed against the right edge. B keeps the hand and heart together and leaves the headline readable, but the art is shrunk to a small thumbnail with a large dead gap between the headline and the image. The CTA and contact lines are crowded together, the contact lines sit hard against the bottom edge, and 'call1-888' runs together, so B still needs real fixes before it ships.
